newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WOOLMER SURPRISED BY WAUGH BOAST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WOOLMER SURPRISED BY WAUGH BOAST.

text.p: South Africa coach Bob Woolmer on Saturday expressed surprise at Steve Waugh's pre-match boast that Australia could not lose the current second test.
Speaking after the second day's play during which South Africa dismissed Australia for 108 and then reached 83 without loss to build a lead of 184, Woolmer told reporters:
"I'm rather surprised that Steve said that. It's not the kind of thing that most cricketers would ever say because this game has a habit of biting you back."

Waugh, buoyed by his side's emphatic victory in the first test, said before the match: "Australia just can't lose. I know it's a big statement but, the way we are playing at the moment, we can't lose. South Africa can't win, it's as simple as that."

South African captain Hansie Cronje, responding to Waugh's comments on Thursday, the day before the test, said: "They (Australia) are obviously very confident. Hopefully that extends to over-confidence."
